title: Acyclicity under concatenation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $gs$ and $hs$ be lists of gates. If every gate at position $i$ in $gs$ refers only to indices less than $n+i$, and every gate at position $i$ in $hs$ refers only to indices less than $n+|gs|+i$, then every gate at position $i$ in the concatenated list $gs$ followed by $hs$ refers only to indices less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: $gs$ satisfies the acyclicity bound starting at $n$
$hs$ satisfies the acyclicity bound starting at $n+|gs|$
